item.rs_create_compat.universal_storage_: A universal storage disk that can store items, fluids and gases at the same time.
block.rs_create_compat.range_charger.too: Powered by the RS network or any FE source. Charges blocks and dropped items in range.
Right-click to open the GUI and adjust the range (default 50x50x50).
block.rs_create_compat.quantity_keeper.t: Marks an object and keeps its quantity stable: autocrafts when low, destroys when over.
Requires the RS network. Autocrafting needs an Autocrafting Upgrade.
